property_summary: For every admissible input, C's fallback must revert (leaving balance and pastBlockTime untouched) whenever msg.value is not exactly 10 ether, and succeed only when it is exactly 10 ether; the mutant, having dropped the require, accepts any other value and updates pastBlockTime, breaking this rule for amounts != 10 ether.
change_summary: Remove the require that msg.value equals 10 ether.
